A workshop where you'll make an outdoor knife using recycled steel from light truck leaf springs as your material.

【Fee】
¥8,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, materials, etc.)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop staff

【What to bring】
Dust-protection goggles, rubber gloves or leather gloves (standard ones from a home center are fine), lunch

【More information】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop website: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
